policy: The suites a delivery is measured by are declared here, not discovered by guesswork and not chosen by the caller. A suite that counts contributes its discovered cases to the TESTS denominator and its case identifiers to evidence resolution, so a test reference cannot resolve against a suite nobody declared and a suite cannot be dropped from the denominator by an invocation. A suite that does not count says why, because a silent omission and a justified one are different states.

suites.title: Development control plane suite
suites.purpose: The SETUP-00 tooling: the ledger, the policies, the schemas and their guardrails.

suites.title: Foundation backend suite
suites.purpose: The FastAPI application, its configuration, its persistence and its dependencies.

suites.title: Model Gateway suite
suites.purpose: The provider-neutral boundary: the contracts, the protocol adapters, the catalog, the router, the resilience policies, streaming and secret containment.

suites.title: Agent Runtime suite
suites.purpose: The agent runtime: the state machine, the event log, profiles and teams, the turn protocol, context assembly, budgets, the tool-request lifecycle and the engine.

suites.title: Sandbox suite
suites.purpose: The sandbox: its contracts, tool registry and policy, the path resolver, patching, the service's decisions, recovery, telemetry, and the isolation, limits, tools and lifecycle asserted against the real container engine.

suites.title: Quality Engine suite

inputRepositories.notCountedReason: Input projects executed by live quality scenarios, including intentional failures, are not evaluator regression cases. The unchanged evaluator conftest already excludes these repositories from pytest collection. Live scenario evidence remains mandatory.

suites.purpose: The Quality Engine: contracts, project profiles, policy, planning, sandbox-only execution, immutable evidence, persistence, lifecycle, APIs, and fail-closed verdicts.

suites.title: Experience Store domain suite
suites.purpose: Closed source-bound contracts, privacy, default-denial rights, stable identity and retention. Real SQL/HTTP/migration controls also run in the counted API integration suite.

suites.title: Foundation infrastructure smoke suite
suites.purpose: Our own configuration of PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, Temporal, Prometheus and Grafana, exercised against the running stack.

suites.title: Foundation frontend suite
suites.notCountedReason: The cases are TypeScript and are collected by Angular/Vitest inside the toolchain container. The Python static count derivation cannot enumerate them. Their complete recorded mandatory webTests execution is evidence, not an invented Python denominator.
suites.purpose: The Angular application shell, the Foundation status rendering and the API configuration.

suites.title: Desktop CLI and shared authenticated core
suites.notCountedReason: Node collects the CommonJS cases at execution. The Python static enumerator cannot derive these IDs; the complete mandatory clientTests gate executes them, and a counted Python mutation guard executes its actual causal Node case.
suites.purpose: CLI, authenticated protocol, consent preview, bounded transport and truthful uncertain recovery decisions.

suites.title: Native editor API decision suite
suites.notCountedReason: Node collects API decision cases at execution. Mandatory clientTests runs every case; these explicit doubles are not native installation or live runtime acceptance.
suites.purpose: Trust, exact approvals, stale consent, plaintext, SecretStorage boundary, lifecycle recovery and disposal decisions.

suites.title: Actual isolated VS Code Extension Host
suites.notCountedReason: A real isolated editor host executes the native installation/workflow proof. It cannot be enumerated by Python without executing the editor; the mandatory full verifier records its separate live acceptance.
suites.purpose: Fresh VSIX installation, actual native approvals, trusted/untrusted workspaces, real runtime task and reload recovery.
